sentences.text:
Sk,J
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice K.Sarath
 Writ Petition No.22349 of 2011
Order:

1. This Writ Petition is filed questioning the action of the respondents in trying to interfere with the possession petitioner in respect of his lands admeasuring Ac.1.00 Guntas of land situated in Sy.No.1301 of Siddipet village and Mandal of Medak District and sought a direction to the respondents not to evict the petitioner from the subject land without following due process of law.

2. Heard the learned Counsel for the petitioner and the learned Assistant Government Pleader Land Acquisition appearing for the respondents.
3.

The learned Counsel for the petitioner submits that while admitting the Writ Petition this Court passed interim orders on 08.08.2011 directing the SK,J respondents not to interfere with the possession of the petition in respect of the subject land of the petitioner without following due process of law and in view of the said interims orders the respondents are not interfering with the possession of the petitioner over the subject land and requested to pass appropriate orders.

4. In view of the submission made by the learned Counsel for the petitioner, this Writ Petition is disposed of directing the respondents not to interfere with the possession of the petitioner over the subject property, without following due process of law.

If the respondents wants to acquire the land of the petitioner they have to follow the procedure as contemplated under Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
